params.command:
python3 -c "
import re
p = 'core/praxis_hook.py'
s = open(p).read()
pattern = r'    def grow_pipeline\(.*?(?=    def on_conversation_started)'
match = re.search(pattern, s, re.DOTALL)
if not match:
    print('ERROR: grow_pipeline method not found')
    exit(1)
new_s = s[:match.start()] + s[match.end():]
assert 'def grow_pipeline' not in new_s, 'method still present'
assert 'def on_conversation_started' in new_s, 'on_conversation_started missing'
open(p, 'w').write(new_s)
print('REMOVED')
"
